summary: Corvus Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose final Phase 1 clinical trial data for soquelitinib in atopic dermatitis. The filing is a routine clinical update under Items 7.01 and 8.01. It reports safety and efficacy results from a 72-patient study, including EASI 75/90 and IGA 0/1 rates. No transaction, special event, or corporate action is being announced. This is purely a scientific disclosure with no special-situation implications.
